{{nihongo|'''Kanbara Shrine'''|蒲原神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Echigo Province]].

=== History ===
The original shrine was “Ōmi no Yashiro,” said to have stood on Kinbachi-yama, with Shiinezu-hiko as principal deity, alongside five-element deities (fire, water, wood, metal, earth), and others including Sugawara no Michizane.

Tradition says samurai {{ill|Hatakeyama Shigemune|ja|畠山重宗|qid=Q61055753}} of early Kamakura period is enshrined here, so it is also called “Rokurō-sama.”
